open_points.subject: Owner and staff actors
open_points.text: **Owner / staff** — create, correct and archive projects and record customers
open_points.question: Are owner and staff one actor, or distinct actors; if distinct, who qualifies as staff and which privileges belong only to the owner besides changing configuration?
options: Owner and staff are the same actor
Owner is a privileged member of staff
Owner and staff are separate actors with separate trust boundaries
open_points.default_guess: Treat the owner as a privileged member of staff: both use the shared staff credential for API actions, while only the owner administers hosts, configuration and secrets.

open_points.subject: Operator forms and model-provider disclosure
open_points.text: **Operator** — `onboard_object`, or an agent preparing a client message for the owner ... every contact field it records or reads passes to the provider of the model the owner runs it on
open_points.question: Does every use of `onboard_object` necessarily run through a model agent and disclose contact data to a model provider, or can the script be used directly without that disclosure?
options: The script can run directly without a model provider
The script and model agent are separate actors with different data flows
open_points.default_guess: Treat the script and model agent as separate operator forms; only model-mediated use sends contact data to the model provider.

open_points.subject: Personal-data readers
open_points.text: every contact field it records or reads passes to the provider of the model the owner runs it on ... **Personal data** — the customer's contact data (R0-06); readable by staff only (R0-09).
open_points.question: Are model providers authorized recipients of customer contact data, or does “readable by staff only” prohibit disclosure to anyone outside staff?
options: Staff-only describes API authorization; approved model providers may receive the data
Only staff may receive the data, so model-provider disclosure is prohibited
Model providers are treated as part of the staff trust boundary
open_points.default_guess: Interpret staff-only as an API authorization rule and treat the owner's chosen model provider as an explicitly accepted external recipient.
